messages:
maya: OK team — finalizing plan for 'Community Cheer Tour' (mini pop-ups at three offices) next Wed–Fri. Need volunteers + spot-award envelopes & kiosk setup.
jamal: I can do Wed morning for setup at SF. What's the pickup time for swag boxes?
maya: Swag pickup scheduled 8:30am at 3rd floor storage. @alex will bring the kiosk table. Checklist: envelopes, stickers, name tags, confetti pouches, spot-award cards (40).
alex: Confirmed table + power strip. Need AV? I can bring extension cord and battery speaker.
priya: I can staff Thu in NYC 11–2. Will need training on award redemption flow — quick runbook pls.
maya: Added a 5-min runbook below — copy for volunteers: '1) greet, 2) scan QR, 3) hand envelope, 4) log redemption in sheet'.
sofia: Link to sign-up form: https://forms.gle/xyz123 (pls pick shift + office).
elliot: Budget check — alert: we have 45 spot award envelopes budgeted. Confirming electronic redemptions allowed for remote folks?
maya: Yes remote folks get e-card codes — Priya, can you own remote code distro? We'll reserve 20 codes.
priya: Happy to take it. I'll need the code list & email template.
maya: Draft announcement for comms: 'Pop-up this week — stop by for snacks, stickers, and surprise spot-awards. Remote? Submit a shoutout here and we'll email a surprise.' Thoughts?
alex: :thumbsup: Nice. Add line about time slots and RSVP required.
jamal: Logistics note: confetti pouches must be in sealed bags for travel. Also need a small float of cash for coffee voucher redemptions — $150 total?
elliot: Approved $150 petty cash. Please get receipts.
maya: Volunteer rota updated in sheet. Final volunteers: Wed SF (maya, jamal, alex), Thu NYC (priya, sofia), Fri remote push (maya, priya).
sofia: Can someone add a photo release blurb to the sign? 'By attending you consent to photos used internally.'
maya: Added that line. Also tagging @ops-bot: can we get a small Slack banner scheduled Tue morning with link to signup?
ops-bot: Banner scheduled for Tue 09:00. Posting channel: #general, #nyc-office, #sf-office.
priya: I'll draft the email for remote recipients and share by EOD.
alex: One last ask — can we get 10 extra sticker sheets? Where to order quick?
jamal: We have a contact at PrintCo — I'll ping them now. ETA 24 hours for local pickup.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll bring the first batch of envelopes to storage tonight. If anything urgent, DM me. :sparkles:
